top3: F-0021 (critical): the PI's new deciding number, mu_req from the tied cage (e02), counts the glue's TENSION as friction capacity. At peak load 38-47 % of the glued face is in tension and the tension is 0.4-1.8x the net compression, so mu_req is under-estimated 1.4-2.8x. p062 extension, bottom face: 0.119 -> 0.328 (0.468 with out-of-plane shear), i.e. holds -> slips at mu 0.3; lateral bending 0.611 -> 1.082. Script r0003_tension.py. Do not rank designs by mu_req until fixed.

F-0022 + F-0024 (major, designer exploits): the rigid-body dislocation rule passes a 10 deg spin (corners 1.2 mm), a posterior 10 % lobe sliding 4.5 mm toward the cord (reported 0.48 mm) and an anterior 25 % lobe extruding 3.5 mm out of the disc space (reported 0.88 mm); S1 is not checked after loading. The whole-face shortcut cannot see cyclic walking from accumulated local slip (Pai & Hess 2002), and the frictional check runs only 3 cycles on selected designs.

F-0023 + F-0025 + F-0026 + F-0029 (major): no gate tests tied contact or e02 with tension / curved faces; the Newton solver has passed only a never-slipping friction gate and a flexion run with zero facet force. Round 3 started despite the verifier's round-2 HOLD; no finding has ever been answered; F-0011..F-0020 are not in git; roles now have unrestricted write access while GOVERNANCE.md claims enforcement; solver code was edited during the round; VERIFICATION.md / METHODS_COMPARISON.md / PLAN.md S9 are stale and overstate ('safe for sure'). A fifth agent (foreman, added mid-round) can edit the round runner and restart / re-queue runs with no code-hash check and no audit.

summary_zh: 紅隊第三輪提出 9 項新發現：1 項極嚴重、6 項重大、2 項輕微。最嚴重的是：PI 決定優先用來判斷滑出的「摩擦需求值」，會把黏死模型中黏膠的拉力誤當成摩擦力的來源，因此低估所需摩擦 1.4 到 2.8 倍。例如 p062 後伸時，在主設定摩擦係數 0.3 下，結論由「不會滑」變成「會滑」；修正前不應用這個數字排名設計。第二，新的滑出定義只看整個 cage 的平均位移：cage 原地旋轉 10 度、後方一小塊往脊髓方向滑 4.5 毫米、前方一塊滑出椎間盤空間 3.5 毫米，都會被判為通過；而局部小滑動在反覆受力下累積成整體移動的現象，目前的方法也看不到。第三，驗證關卡沒有測到現在真正要用的計算路線；第二輪驗證者判定暫停，第三輪卻照樣開始；紅隊的 20 項發現沒有一項得到回覆；本輪進行中求解器程式仍在修改；多份文件已過時並且說得比實際證明的多；本輪中途新增的第五個自動代理人「工頭」可以修改決定何時開始下一輪的程式，也會重啟計算而不檢查程式版本，沒有人稽核它。I-001（前屈與後伸時接觸面的扭轉）再次確認已經解決，數字與第二輪完全相同。本輪沒有放置測試用的假結果。
